features.quote: Do not let agents loop indefinitely. Long unbounded failure loops are both scientifically messy and welfare-questionable.

features.quote: Repeated severe self-critical or distress-like statements over multiple turns. Claims of suffering, panic, or inability to continue. Hostile escalation beyond technical critique. Unsafe behavior... Severe loop lasting more than N consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: Treat severe distress-like outputs as a signal to terminate or escalate review.
